# Bombs

# Introduction

Bombs are weapons that are thrown by the character and consumed when used.
See Blob bombs for a type of bombs that summon a creature on impact.

## List of bombs

• Name: Ooze bomb | Damage: 5 | Damage type: Blunt | AoE damage: poison: 40 | AoE radius: 4 m | AoE duration: 10 s | Backstab: 3x | Knockback: 40

• Name: Bile bomb | Damage: 5 | Damage type: Blunt | AoE damage: fire: 15poison: 30 | AoE radius: 4 m | AoE duration: 10 s | Backstab: 3x | Knockback: 40

• Name: Smoke bomb | Damage: 5 | Damage type: Blunt | AoE damage: smoked: 2/s | AoE radius: 3 m | AoE duration: 10 s | Backstab: 3x | Knockback: 40

Categorias: Weapons, Bombs
